description: Browse free textbooks for a course topic. It lists matching OpenStax books and open access books from the Directory of Open Access Books (DOAB). Inputs: subject (a course topic such as "calculus", "nursing" or "economics") and an optional limit of 1 to 25 results. OpenStax books come first. If DOAB is down the OpenStax list still comes back and the reply says so. Example prompt: "List free textbooks for intro statistics."

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

subject.description: A course topic or subject, like "calculus", "statistics", "nursing" or "economics".

name: list_open_textbooks_by_subject

results.description: Free textbooks for the subject, OpenStax first and then DOAB.

access.description: "free" means a free copy you can keep or read online, "borrow" means a free loan, "none" means no free copy is known.

authors.description: Authors or editors, when the source lists them.

note.description: One sentence on what kind of copy this is.

source.description: Where the book was found: "OpenStax", "DOAB" or "Open Library".

url.description: Page where you can read or download the book.

year.description: Year of publication, when the source gives one.

sources_unavailable.description: Names of the sources that did not answer, so a short list can be told from a failed search.

title: Browse open textbooks by subject
